## Claims
- [source-backed] L69 — **prior proposition:** “see also [ C92 , Cor. 4.4] and [ GR02 , Prop. 2.1]”; it supports the ensuing cell-decomposition presentation and surjection \(H^\star(G/B)\to H^\star(X_w)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 67-84]
- [source-backed] L91 — **prior result:** “[ GR02 ] reduced the \(|W|=n!\) upper bound … to a polynomial bound of \(n^2\)” for varieties defined by inclusions. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 89-103]
- [source-backed] L200 — **comparison/subsumption claim:** the paper’s result “subsumes (and slightly improves upon; see Example 4.9) the generating set of size \(n^2\) given by [ GR02 ].” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 194-205]
- [source-backed] L727 — **conventions/bijection background:** “This bijection can be inferred from the discussion in [ FP98 ] and [ GR02 ] (our conventions are in line with those the latter text).” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 722-730]
- [source-backed] L901 — **terminology attribution:** varieties for which all Schubert conditions are inclusions “were called Schubert varieties defined by inclusions in [ GR02 ].” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 893-912]
- [source-backed] L934 — **methodological commentary:** “the techniques utilized in [ GR02 ] seem very particular to the case where \(X_w\) is defined by inclusions.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 927-937]
- [source-backed] L1147 — **subclass reference:** the question names “[ GR02 , HLSS07 , OPY07 ]” as recently studied subclasses “where \(I_w\) can be generated by \(n^2\) elements.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1143-1160]
- [source-backed] L1232 — **bibliography entry:** “[GR02] V. Gasharov and V. Reiner, *Cohomology of smooth Schubert varieties in partial flag manifolds*, *J. London Math. Soc.* 66 (2002), no. 3, 550–562.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1232-1235]
